merchant/31273.htm.text: Blueprint Seller Borodin: Come to look at blueprints? We even used to have some designed by Master Tobald, but now that technique can be acquired without the need for blueprints!

Q00100_SagaOfTheMaestro/1-01.htm.text: Blueprint Seller Borodin: That's right! I've been asked to repair one of Master Tobald's inventions! What an honor! Master Toma's development of the spatial movement device was amazing, but a machine that lets you travel through time is something, isn't it?

links.text: "I heard that you are having a problem making the repairs."

Q00100_SagaOfTheMaestro/1-03.htm.text: Blueprint Seller Borodin: Welcome back! You've brought the ice crystals that produce a temperature of absolute zero! I can fix the cooling system easily with these! I heard you killed Bumbalump! Is that true? Awesome!

Q00100_SagaOfTheMaestro/1-02.htm.text: Blueprint Seller Borodin: You're really narrow-minded, aren't you? Look! I must have ice crystals to repair Wilma #3! You'll find them in the hot springs area in the north part of Goddard. Chef Jeremy can tell you more.

Q00100_SagaOfTheMaestro/1-04.htm.text: Blueprint Seller Borodin: Why are you back? I fixed the cooling system of Wilma #3 and gave it to you to take to Master Tobald ! Get going!

Q00100_SagaOfTheMaestro/1-05.htm.text: Blueprint Seller Borodin: Ha! I'm embarrassed to say, but that's what happened. Honestly, I need a very powerful coolant to repair such a huge cooling system...
